## Unification policy

Korean unification policy, with particular attention to the German experience of reunification and the political and social integration that followed it.

## Cold War intellectual history

The intellectual history of the Cold War era: how political ideas were formed, circulated, and contested under the conditions of division.

## Global conceptual history (liberal democracy)

The global conceptual history of "liberal democracy" — how the concept was formed, translated, and put to use in different political contexts, including Korea.

## Teaching

- Nineteenth-century European political thought (graduate seminar)
